About me

I am a Biotechnology and Genetic Engineering graduate of Khulna University, Bangladesh, currently pursuing an MS in the same discipline.

My research background is in microbial enzymes, and my MS research addresses the targeted genetic improvement of bacterial strains.

I aim to pursue a PhD or funded master's position in the USA, Europe or Korea, or a graduate-level role in Bangladesh.
